title: From Gradient-Boosted Trees to Deep Recommenders: Practical Lessons from Migrating a Production Customer Support Recommender
abstract: arXiv:2608.24132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Product catalogs in fast-moving service businesses are shifting from static, independently priced SKUs toward dynamically bundled, discount-coupled offerings--a shift that strains the tree-based classifiers traditionally preferred for sparse and highly imbalanced data. These classifiers assume a fixed, slowly changing label space and struggle to incorporate multimodal signals such as tabular data and transcripts. We present the migration of a live, production conversational recommendation system from a gradient-boosted multiclass model to a pairwise-binary deep recommender. Because this system is critical to ecosystem growth initiatives and downstream features like dynamic pitching--surfacing the most relevant pitch text to a support agent in real time during a live customer conversation--maintaining live recommendation quality was a non-negotiable constraint. We detail the techniques that made this migration successful--reformulating

translated_title: 从梯度提升树到深度推荐系统：迁移生产级客户支持推荐器的实践教训
translated_abstract: 在快速发展的服务业务中，产品目录正从静态、独立定价的SKU转向动态捆绑、折扣耦合的优惠组合——这一转变给传统上用于稀疏和高度不平衡数据的树基分类器带来了压力。这些分类器假设标签空间固定且变化缓慢，难以整合多模态信号，如表格数据和对话记录。我们展示了一个实际生产环境中的对话推荐系统从梯度提升多类模型迁移到成对二分类深度推荐器的过程。由于该系统对生态增长举措和下游功能（如动态提案——在实时客户对话中向支持代理展示最相关的提案文本）至关重要，保持实时推荐质量是不可妥协的约束。我们详细介绍了使此迁移成功的技术——重新制定问题表述。
tldr: 本文通过实际生产系统迁移案例，展示了从梯度提升树到深度推荐器的成功转型方法，重点解决了动态标签空间和多模态数据整合挑战，并保持了实时推荐质量。
en_tdlr: This paper presents practical lessons from migrating a production conversational recommender from gradient-boosted trees to a deep pairwise-binary model, addressing dynamic label spaces and multimodal integration while maintaining live quality.
